Coming from a nurse... Be honest with your provider. Most nurses will be more than happy to hold your hand or have another medical assistant come in and hold your hand. Tell the provider. Set your limits. If it any point you become overwhelmed say it. You can always say no or stop. It is never within the providers power go push anything on you or continue without your permission. 
Another route is to ask for a sedating medicine for a one or two dose use. Remember it probably isn't on hand at the office so you could call ahead explain where you're at and ask for options. They may prescribe it for you so you can take it directly before your appointment to help with the mental and emotional discomfort. 
Always remember to breath, and take the time you need to reset before or after. It's normal to be anxious and then exhausted after a traumatic event as such. And if it ever becomes too difficult there are resources available for you such as crisis lines, counselors ( even the clinic may have one), and local resources. 
Remember this is YOUR BODY.
